a ridiculous price: The small bottle of water at the airport cost a ridiculous price, almost five times what it costs in a supermarket.
機場的一小瓶水賣到離譜的價格，幾乎是超市售價的五倍。
look ridiculous: I refused to wear the pink rabbit costume to the party because I knew I would look ridiculous in it.
我拒絕穿粉紅兔子裝去派對，因為我知道我穿起來會看起來很可笑。
Don't be ridiculous!: "Don't be ridiculous! You can't walk all the way to Kaohsiung," my mom laughed when I shared my plan.
我說出計畫時，我媽笑著說：「別鬧了！你不可能一路走到高雄。」
It is ridiculous that…: It is ridiculous that we have to pay for parking at the hospital when we are visiting sick family members.
我們去醫院探望生病的家人還得付停車費，這很荒謬。
rigid rules: The school has rigid rules about uniforms, so even a different color of socks can get you in trouble.
這所學校對制服有死板的規定，所以連襪子顏色不同都可能讓你惹上麻煩。
a rigid schedule: With a rigid schedule of classes from morning till night, the students had no time to relax.
因為從早到晚排滿課的僵硬時間表，學生們完全沒有時間放鬆。
rigid thinking: Rigid thinking will not help you solve this puzzle; you need to try ideas that seem strange at first.
僵化的思維無法幫你解開這道謎題；你需要嘗試一開始看起來很奇怪的點子。
be rigid with fear: When the huge dog ran toward her, the little girl seemed to be rigid with fear and could not move.
當那隻大狗朝她衝過來時，小女孩似乎嚇得僵硬，完全動彈不得。
a rigid structure: A tent needs a rigid structure of metal poles; otherwise it will fall down in strong wind.
帳篷需要金屬支架構成的剛性結構，否則在強風中就會倒塌。
the time is ripe for: Now that everyone has a smartphone, the time is ripe for our school to offer more online classes.
既然現在人人都有智慧型手機，我們學校開設更多線上課程的時機成熟了。
ripe for change: After years of complaints from students, the old lunch system was ripe for change.
在學生多年的抱怨之後，舊的午餐制度改革時機已到。
live to a ripe old age: My great-grandfather ate simple food, walked every day, and managed to live to a ripe old age of ninety-eight.
我曾祖父吃得簡單、每天散步，最後活到九十八歲的高壽。
ripe fruit: Ripe fruit like bananas and mangoes should be eaten within a few days before it goes bad.
像香蕉和芒果這類成熟的果實應該在幾天內吃掉，以免壞掉。
a ripe cheese: The French restaurant served a ripe cheese with a strong smell, but it tasted soft and creamy.
那家法國餐廳端上一塊氣味濃烈的熟成起司，但吃起來柔軟又滑順。
a risky business: Opening a restaurant is a risky business, because many new restaurants close within their first year.
開餐廳是一件有風險的事，因為許多新餐廳在第一年內就倒閉了。
a risky venture: Putting all his savings into a new online shop was a risky venture, but it turned out to be a success.
把所有積蓄投入一間新的網路商店是個冒險的事業，但結果很成功。
risky behavior: Riding a scooter without a helmet is risky behavior that can lead to serious injuries.
騎機車不戴安全帽是危險的行為，可能導致嚴重受傷。
too risky to try: The climbers wanted to reach the top, but with the storm coming, it was too risky to try.
登山客們想攻頂，但暴風雨即將來襲，太冒險而不敢嘗試。
a ritual greeting: "How are you?" is often just a ritual greeting, and most people don't expect a long answer.
「你好嗎？」常常只是例行公事式的招呼，大多數人並不期待聽到很長的回答。
ritual behavior: Before every game, the pitcher touches his cap three times, a kind of ritual behavior that calms him down.
每場比賽前，那位投手都會摸帽子三下，這是一種讓他冷靜下來的儀式化行為。
a daily ritual: Drinking a cup of hot tea while reading the news is a daily ritual for my grandfather every morning.
每天早上邊喝熱茶邊看新聞是我爺爺每日的固定儀式。
a rival company: After ten years at the bank, he left and took a better job at a rival company across the street.
在銀行工作十年後，他離職並到對街的競爭對手公司接了一份更好的工作。
a rival team: Our basketball team practiced every day because we wanted to beat a rival team from the next town.
我們籃球隊每天練習，因為我們想打敗鄰鎮的敵隊。
rival claims: Two neighbors made rival claims to the same piece of land, so they had to go to court to settle it.
兩位鄰居對同一塊土地提出相互對立的主張，所以他們必須上法院解決。
without rival: The beef noodles at this small shop are without rival; no other restaurant in the city can match them.
這家小店的牛肉麵無與倫比；城裡沒有其他餐廳比得上。
rival factions: The club broke into two rival factions, each wanting its own leader to become president.
這個社團分裂成兩個敵對派系，各自都想讓自己的領袖當上社長。
roast beef: For Christmas dinner, my aunt cooked roast beef with potatoes and carrots in the oven.
聖誕晚餐時，我阿姨用烤箱做了烤牛肉配馬鈴薯和紅蘿蔔。
roast chestnuts: In winter, street sellers in Taipei sell roast chestnuts in paper bags, and the sweet smell fills the air.
冬天時，台北的街頭小販用紙袋裝著賣糖炒栗子，香甜的氣味瀰漫在空氣中。
a roast dinner: Every Sunday, the British family has a roast dinner with chicken, vegetables, and gravy.
每個星期天，那個英國家庭都會吃一頓有雞肉、蔬菜和肉汁的烤肉大餐。
roast someone: At every birthday party, his friends love to roast him with funny stories, but he always laughs the loudest.
每次生日派對上，他的朋友都愛用好笑的故事狠狠嘲諷他，但他總是笑得最大聲。
